bounded_unit.target: Cargo package.build=false automatic build-script discovery suppression
bounded_unit.finding: The official Cargo manifest reference states that package.build defaults to build.rs and that build=false disables automatic detection of the build script. This validates only the narrow manifest-level mechanism for suppressing Cargo's automatic build.rs discovery in a package copy whose own manifest is set to build=false.
bounded_unit.verified_scope: Cargo package.build field semantics for default build.rs discovery and build=false suppression; documentation-only, no Cargo execution.
bounded_unit.not_verified_scope: Whether a specific alternate crate remains correct without its build script; package.links compatibility; native/generated artifacts; alternate-source preparation; [patch] compatibility for any specific crate; actual compilation; end-to-end richer-mode parity.

scope_guard: Do not generalize build=false into proof that arbitrary build scripts are optional or that disabling one preserves package correctness.
exact_continuation: On the next invocation, fresh-bootstrap and SHA-only validate current authority, then run one bounded official-source leaf on Cargo package.links requirements and build-script overriding semantics to determine whether links-bearing crates conflict with the build=false substitution path. Keep specific-crate compatibility, native/generated artifacts, alternate-source preparation and actual build execution unresolved; do not run Cargo or start a second leaf.
